faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about restaurant website design.

items.question: What video formats are supported?
items.answer: MP4 and WebM formats work best. Videos are compressed automatically for fast loading. Keep videos under 30 seconds for the best mobile experience.

items.question: Will a video background slow down my website?
items.answer: No. Videos are compressed, lazy-loaded, and optimized automatically. On slow connections, the system falls back to a static image to keep the experience smooth.

items.question: Can I use a photo instead of video?
items.answer: Yes. Upload any photo — it will be optimized and displayed as a full-screen background. You can switch between video and photo anytime.

items.question: Do I need a designer to set this up?
items.answer: No. Just upload your video or photo from the dashboard. The system handles sizing, compression, and layout automatically. Your website looks professional with zero design skills.

items.question: Can AI generate a background for me?
items.answer: Yes. If you don't have your own video or photo, AI can generate a background image based on your restaurant's menu and style. It's available directly from the Design settings.

items.question: Is custom background available on the free plan?
items.answer: Background customization is available on Basic and Pro plans. The free plan includes your accent color and a clean default design.

items.question: Can I hide the restaurant title on the homepage?
items.answer: Yes. If your background video or photo already shows your restaurant name, you can toggle off the title overlay from the Design settings for a cleaner look.
